description: NaPrTe₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fd̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Te²⁻ atoms to form NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PrTe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent PrTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. All Na-Te bond lengths are 3.27 Å. Pr³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Te²⁻ atoms to form PrTe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaTe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent PrTe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. All Pr-Te bond lengths are 3.21 Å. Te²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Pr³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing TeNa₃Pr₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
